description: Downstream overlay of the vendored memengine. Every path listed here is COD-NA-ONLY: upstream thyn-ai/telys
(packages/memengine-py) has never shipped it, so the automated sync from telys main must PRESERVE it rather
than mirror its absence. telys' sync-memengine-to-codna.yml runs `rsync -a --delete` from a source tree that
cannot contain these files, so --delete removes them on every sync; main's 5a13cd08 restored them once and
77868391 removed them again, and PR #697 (c7a64c05) did it a third time. This manifest is the machine-checked
record that makes the next recurrence fail loudly in codna CI instead of at a downstream release.
There is a SECOND mirroring path: scripts/sync_wheel_memengine_from_staged_runtime.py at publish time
rmtree's cli/memengine and copytree's the engine staged from the signed telys bundle, which has the same
absence. It now preserves every path listed here (see _preserved from this manifest) so a release cannot strip
the fallback even if a sync PR were merged without the restore.
Do not add a file here without a test that exercises it; see cli/tests/test_memengine_overlay.py.

preserve.why: Pure-NumPy reference implementation of every kernel primitive (AGENTS.md 24.8). The baseline the native path is compared against in cli/tests/test_pynative_equivalence.py and the whole degraded-mode story for platforms with no Mojo wheel (Windows today).

ctypes-shaped adapter that answers the kernel's C ABI using _pynative, so mojo_backend._lib() can substitute it with no second code path. Without it there is no fallback at all: the engine raises FileNotFoundError on any platform with no shared library.

overlaid_modules.why: backend_kind() makes 'which backend answered?' a question a program can ask (CONSUMERS: cli/codna/runtime_capabilities.py, python/codna_parity/telys_localize.py, ide bundle-telys.js preflight, bench).

Tie handling that reproduces the BM25 kernels' top-k contract, so the pure-Python fallback cannot order ties the opposite way from the native kernel. Reinstate requires _pynative.py (_bm25_insert_topk).
LocalRuntime declares the compact serve-artifact capability it actually implements; cli/codna/runtime_capabilities.py reads these flags because hasattr() is true even when the method raises.
Native shadow of the local sealer's compact export, byte-identical by test (cli/tests/test_native_compact_export.py). Upstream replaced it with a bare NotImplementedError.
